_comment: A film preset. convert.cube renders Apple Log straight through a stock baked from spektrafilm
(luts/film/CHANGELOG.txt), so look, print and tone are neutral: a curve on top would bend the
stock's own. Each clip's exposure and white balance are metered in linear before the cube
(scripts/solve-exposure.py) against match.reference_stops; correct.* still adds on top.
Fujifilm Pro 400H on 35mm, a lab scan: +1 stop, pastel, cyan-leaning highlights. 35mm
grain, heavier than the medium-format preset.
name: Pro 400H 35mm
